description: RPL messages (DIS/DIO/DAO/DAO-ACK per RFC 6550) with hardcoded independent vectors from spec.

vectors.name: dio_base
vectors.description: LICHEN root RPL DIO whose DODAGID is AddrForKey for the deterministic all-zero identity seed, with the mandatory current SCHC Rule Version option.

vectors.name: dio_non_root
vectors.description: LICHEN non-root parent DIO propagates the root's AddrForKey DODAGID and mandatory current SCHC Rule Version unchanged.

vectors.name: dio_explicit_version_2
vectors.description: An explicit single canonical version option is preserved byte-for-byte so admission can reject a genuine remote mismatch.

vectors.name: dio_malformed_version_length_zero
vectors.description: A Type 0x13 option with Length zero is not canonical and cannot be serialized.

vectors.name: dio_malformed_version_length_two
vectors.description: A Type 0x13 option with Length two is not canonical and cannot be serialized.

vectors.name: dio_duplicate_version_option
vectors.description: Two otherwise canonical Type 0x13 options are rejected rather than collapsed or rewritten.

vectors.name: dao_base
vectors.description: Base RPL DAO without DODAGID: D flag is clear, so Rule 4 does not match and the packet uses uncompressed fallback.

vectors.name: dis_base
vectors.description: Normal DODAG Information Solicitation: zero flags, zero reserved, no options (RFC 6550 6.2).

vectors.name: dis_flags_ignored_on_receive
vectors.description: RFC 6550 6.2 DIS flag bits are unused: senders MUST zero them and receivers MUST ignore them, so a decoder preserves rather than rejects or masks any flags value.

vectors.name: dis_solicited_no_dodagid_match
vectors.description: No-DODAGID solicitation via Solicited Information option (RFC 6550 6.6): type 7 length 18, RPLInstanceID 0, VID flags 0xC0 (V+I set, D clear so the carried DODAGID is not matched), AddrForKey DODAGID of the deterministic all-zero identity seed.

vectors.name: dis_truncated
vectors.description: A DIS shorter than its two-byte base object is rejected.

vectors.name: dis_nonzero_reserved
vectors.description: A nonzero DIS Reserved byte violates RFC 6550 6.2 and is rejected instead of ignored.

vectors.name: dao_ack_accept
vectors.description: Successful DAO acknowledgement: status 0, D flag clear so no DODAGID is carried (RFC 6550 6.5).

vectors.name: dao_ack_status_rejected
vectors.description: Non-success DAO-ACK: the codecs carry Status as a raw byte (no enum), so non-zero values are preserved verbatim.

vectors.name: dao_ack_with_dodagid
vectors.description: D-flag DAO-ACK carries the AddrForKey DODAGID of the deterministic all-zero identity seed after the four-byte base.

vectors.name: dao_ack_too_short
vectors.description: A DAO-ACK shorter than its four-byte base object is rejected.

vectors.name: dao_ack_missing_dodagid
vectors.description: D flag set without the sixteen DODAGID bytes that must follow is rejected instead of misparsed.
